item.title: Qualifying claims with insofar as
item.explanation_text:
Use insofar as or to the extent that to specify how far a claim holds. In a review, the qualifying clause can identify the part of the evidence that supports a conclusion. If a review examined weekday services alone, its conclusion about reliability applies insofar as it concerns weekday services. That wording leaves weekend reliability open.

Use provided that or on condition that to state a requirement that must be met for a permission or arrangement to take effect. If researchers may access records provided that they sign a confidentiality agreement, signing is the condition for access. A scope clause can instead specify which parts of the records a permission covers.

Use except where to carve out an exception from a general rule. If a licence permits reuse except where a third party holds copyright, reuse is the default and those cases are excluded. When editing, ask whether the clause defines the reach of a claim, sets a prerequisite, or identifies cases excluded from a default.
item.contrast_text: Insofar as and to the extent that define the reach of a claim or permission. Provided that and on condition that set a prerequisite. Except where introduces cases excluded from a general statement or rule.
item.common_error_pattern: Using provided that for an established limit on what a review supports can make the conclusion sound contingent. Using insofar as for an approval requirement can make permission sound divisible when the rule grants or withholds it as a whole.

examples.bad: [The review assessed delivery times alone.] The review's favourable conclusion is warranted provided that it concerns delivery times.
examples.good: [The review assessed delivery times alone.] The review's favourable conclusion is warranted insofar as it concerns delivery times.

examples.bad: The comparison is valid to the extent the that both surveys used the same sampling method.
examples.good: The comparison is valid to the extent that both surveys used the same sampling method.

examples.bad: [Written consent is a prerequisite for releasing the recording.] The archive may release the recording insofar as the speaker gives written consent.
examples.good: [Written consent is a prerequisite for releasing the recording.] The archive may release the recording on condition that the speaker gives written consent.

examples.bad: [Public access is the default and sealed files are excluded.] The files are open to the public provided that a court has sealed them.
examples.good: [Public access is the default and sealed files are excluded.] The files are open to the public except where a court has sealed them.

children.title: Limit an endorsement to the work observed
children.instructions: Complete the scope qualifier beginning with the single word insofar. The review observed scheduled maintenance and reached a conclusion about that work.
children.prompt_text: The review's endorsement is justified ___ it concerns scheduled maintenance.

children.title: Define which months support a comparison
children.instructions: Complete the four-word qualifier beginning with to. The comparison is valid for the months represented in both datasets.
children.prompt_text: The seasonal comparison is valid ___ it draws on months represented in both datasets.

children.title: State a prerequisite for site access
children.instructions: Complete the permission with a two-word connector beginning with provided. Completing the safety briefing is required before volunteers may enter.
children.prompt_text: Volunteers may enter the excavation area ___ they complete the safety briefing.

children.title: Record a condition of an equipment loan
children.instructions: Insert the three-word connector beginning with on and containing condition. The loan depends on the borrower naming an insured operator.
children.prompt_text: The workshop will lend the press ___ the borrower names an insured operator.

children.title: Exclude a class of records from publication
children.instructions: Complete the two-word exception marker beginning with except and ending with where. Publication is the default and the clause identifies the cases excluded from it.
children.prompt_text: The panel publishes its decisions ___ a decision identifies a protected witness.

children.title: Correct a review's statement of scope
children.instructions: The report evaluated initial response times alone. Replace provided that with a two-word scope qualifier whose first word is insofar. Keep the rest of the sentence unchanged.
children.prompt_text: The report's conclusion about service quality is defensible provided that it addresses initial response times.
accepted_answers: The report's conclusion about service quality is defensible insofar as it addresses initial response times.

children.title: Repair an exception in a retention policy
children.instructions: Deletion is the default. A preservation order exempts the relevant records. Replace only insofar as with except where.
children.prompt_text: The registry deletes expired records insofar as a preservation order applies.
accepted_answers: The registry deletes expired records except where a preservation order applies.

children.title: Recast a finding about partial coverage
children.instructions: Express the limit in one sentence starting with The review supports the estimate. Use to the extent that immediately before the estimate concerns and keep staffed branches.
children.prompt_text: The review supports the estimate for staffed branches alone.
accepted_answers: The review supports the estimate to the extent that the estimate concerns staffed branches.

children.title: Turn a release requirement into a permission clause
children.instructions: Write one sentence starting with The editor may release the appendix. Follow it immediately with on condition that and retain the wording the analyst has verified the figures.
children.prompt_text: Before the editor may release the appendix, the analyst must have verified the figures.
accepted_answers: The editor may release the appendix on condition that the analyst has verified the figures.

children.title: Convert a restriction into a default with an exception
children.instructions: Write one sentence starting with The permit allows access to service roads. Follow it immediately with except where and finish with a seasonal closure is in force.
children.prompt_text: The permit allows access to service roads whenever no seasonal closure is in force.
accepted_answers: The permit allows access to service roads except where a seasonal closure is in force.

children.title: Front the limit on a review finding
children.instructions: Use every tile once. Start with Insofar as and place the tile ending in a comma immediately before the main clause. The finding applies to the audited sites.
children.prompt_text: the finding holds. / the audited sites, / Insofar as / the evidence covers
accepted_answers: Insofar as the evidence covers the audited sites, the finding holds.

children.title: Place a prerequisite after an export permission
children.instructions: Use every tile once. Start with Licensees may and put the provided that clause after the complete permission. The licence requires attribution on each exported chart.
children.prompt_text: carries an attribution. / export the charts / Licensees may / each chart / provided that
accepted_answers: Licensees may export the charts provided that each chart carries an attribution.
